Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: After the Planner identified a critical discrepancy in Carl Boese’s birth year (1887 vs 1897) and explicitly instructed checking authoritative sources (e.g., German Wikipedia, filmportal.de) to resolve it, WebSurfer instead repeated searches for Fritz Lang’s birth date—information already established. This failure to follow instructions and reconcile the conflicting data on Boese prevented correct comparison and could lead to relying on the incorrect 1897 date, producing the wrong conclusion.
